explanation: setup.ts unmounts the page before it resets the URL after each test, because unmounting runs the router's pending URL write and Testing Library's own cleanup runs after this hook; testIsolation.test.tsx pins that order. app.dataset.test.tsx unmounts before it removes the mouse study's seeds, so a mounted page cannot start a load that stays cached for the next test. nomenclature.test.tsx checks that Enter selects the gene typed before the list catches up.
